related.title: GPAW：實空間網格精化與積分不變量
related.titleEn: GPAW: real-space grid refinement and integral invariants
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：收斂聲明只涵蓋已測可觀測量與固定條件，不擴張到所有材料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The convergence claim covers tested observables and fixed conditions only, not every material or property.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「GPAW：實空間網格精化與積分不變量」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付格點索引、兩種網格記憶體下界、積分核對與精化敏感度表。
related.differenceEn: Investigate GPAW: real-space grid refinement and integral invariants using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver index conventions, storage lower bounds for both grids, integral checks and an observable-refinement table that distinguishes requested spacing from the actual discretization.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從動能正比於波向量平方開始，得到半徑正比截止平方根，再以三維球體積推導基底數比例。
計算兩種 N 的三次方，再分別乘八 bytes；把單場值數與軟體的峰值使用量分開。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Start from kinetic energy proportional to squared wavevector magnitude, obtain a reciprocal-space radius proportional to the square root of cutoff, then use three-dimensional sphere volume to derive the count ratio without assuming integer equality.

Cube each one-dimensional count and multiply by eight bytes for a single double-precision field. Keep this arithmetic separate from peak application memory, which may contain multiple fields, states, padding and temporary buffers.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ICON：質量加權示蹤物與網格平均契約
related.titleEn: ICON: mass-weighted tracers and grid-average contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：收斂聲明只涵蓋已測可觀測量與固定條件，不擴張到所有材料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The convergence claim covers tested observables and fixed conditions only, not every material or property.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「ICON：質量加權示蹤物與網格平均契約」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付空氣與示蹤物雙帳本、分區重組證據及乾濕基準對照。
related.differenceEn: Investigate ICON: mass-weighted tracers and grid-average contracts using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver separate air and tracer mass ledgers, partition-recombination evidence and a reference-convention table that identifies every conversion required before combining datasets.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從動能正比於波向量平方開始，得到半徑正比截止平方根，再以三維球體積推導基底數比例。
計算 0.02 與 0.06 kg，再除總空氣質量五；用總示蹤物反推平均作交叉檢查。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Start from kinetic energy proportional to squared wavevector magnitude, obtain a reciprocal-space radius proportional to the square root of cutoff, then use three-dimensional sphere volume to derive the count ratio without assuming integer equality.
Compute tracer masses 0.02 and 0.06 kg and divide their sum by five kilograms of air. Reconstruct total tracer mass from the resulting mean to check that no weighting factor disappeared.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
